profile.ja: ふうま小太郎の執事を務める対魔忍。若い時から一目置かれる戦闘能力をもち、ふうま一族最高のクナイ使いと評されている。また、ふうま一族の特徴をしっかり受け継ぎ、彼女も邪眼使いである。彼女の邪眼は“千里眼”視覚だけを遊離してどこへでも自由自在に潜入できる。遊離した視覚で本やコンピュータなどの情報端末に触れれば、そこに記されている情報を読む事もできる。時子は別次元に飛ばされても諦めずに帰る方法を模索しつつ、装備をより能力に合ったものに更新していく。
profile.en: She serves as the attendant of Fuuma Kotaro, a Taimanin renowned for her exceptional combat abilities since her youth. She is also considered the best kunaichi user in the Fuuma family. Having inherited the family's distinctive traits, she is also a wielder of the evil eye. Her evil eye, known as "Senri Eye," allows her to freely infiltrate anywhere by releasing her visual perception. By touching books, computers, or other information terminals with her released visual perception, she can also read the information contained within. Tokiko, even after being thrown into another dimension, does not give up and continues to search for a way to return while updating her equipment to better suit her abilities.

text.ja: さあ若様、今日も楽しい鍛錬の始まりよ。もし逃げ出そうなんて思ってるなら……わかってるわね？
text.en: Now, Master, let's start today's fun training. If you're thinking of escaping... you understand, don't you?

text.ja: こっちの世界にもようやく慣れてきたわ。若様、いえ、お館様の躾ももう少し厳しくしないといけないわね
text.en: I've finally gotten used to this world. Master, or rather, I should be stricter with your discipline, shouldn't I?

text.ja: こっちの若様にはつい甘い顔をしてしまう。それでいいと思っている自分もいる。でも若様のためにはならないわね……
text.en: I tend to show a softer side to the Master in this world. I think that's okay, but for the Master's sake, it's not good...

text.ja: 今日はあなたが隊長よ、お館様。素早くかつ的確な指示を求めるわ。判断を誤れば任務失敗なんだから気合いを入れるのよ
text.en: Today, you're the captain, Master. I expect quick and accurate instructions. If you make a mistake, the mission will fail, so get ready.

text.ja: 少しは見直したわ。状況分析、敵味方の能力把握、それに応じた指示……若様に隊長としての資質があったなんてね
text.en: I've reevaluated you a bit. Situation analysis, understanding the abilities of both friends and foes, and giving instructions accordingly... I didn't think you had the qualities of a captain, Master.

text.ja: 若様には少なくとも、自分を守れるだけの力を身につけてもらう。そのためには鍛錬あるのみよ、立ちなさい
text.en: I want you to have at least enough power to protect yourself. For that, there's no substitute for training; let's get started.

text.ja: 私が元の世界へ帰るまでみっちりしごいてあげる。お館様が自分の身を守れるくらいには鍛えてあげるわ
text.en: I'll train you thoroughly until I return to my original world. I'll make sure you can protect yourself, Master.

text.ja: 隊長、今日もいい指揮だったわ。こういうのはどこで学んだの？　授業をサボって本を読んでた……？　鍛錬追加ね！
text.en: Captain, you did a great job leading today. Where did you learn this? Did you read books instead of attending classes? Additional training!
